title: 第17章 张绝的前半生第18章 辰宗师叔
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
夜色笼罩整个江宁时，还是在那间富丽堂皇的办公室内。
安焕然身体蜷缩在宽大的高背椅上，打着哈欠听着手下的文官给他念着总督府归总来的那些资料。
“后金天佑27年，江北彭城铁山县的教书先生张城生子张怀希。”
“张怀希初读书，十三年不成，便做了木匠学徒，最后干起了木匠活。”
“新民国10年，张怀希与徐氏结婚，生子张绝，同年一家人为避战祸，从江北搬到了江南江宁城，张怀希依旧做木匠工作。”
“张绝，江南江宁城大王庄人，从小木讷少言，三岁不能说话，徐氏因此怀疑他得了哑症，四处走访寻医，直到四岁才能和人沟通。”
“六岁时，张绝父母送他去学堂，学堂的先生却并不愿意收他，说他天生愚钝，不是读书的料，张绝觉得学堂先生是在骂他，咬了学堂先生的胳膊。”
“此后，从六岁到九岁，张绝一直待在家里由母亲徐氏教导读书，仅读书三年，张绝便能写文作诗，乡野皆传张绝天赋斐然，是文曲星下凡。”
“张绝九岁时，张怀希响应新民国政府宣传，参军加入北伐军，彼时护法战争打响，张怀希在京甫战役中阵亡。”
“正值护法战争关键时刻，新民国政府为扩充兵源，鼓动更多人参军，建立了护法英灵园，张怀希被选入园区安葬，阵亡抚恤也被江宁城时任市长亲手送进家门。”
“江宁城市长见到张绝后，感慨其父忠勇，为他取字——绍先。”
“当时徐氏已重病缠身，拿到抚恤后，任凭张绝如何哭劝，却一直不愿拿钱为自己治病，而是将钱藏起来，直到临死前才告知张绝，让他用抚恤去读散星法师预科学校。”
“张绝听从了徐氏遗愿，正式进入预科学校读书，初入学校时，不管是老师还是学生，对他的评价都是发奋图强、埋头苦学。”
“但在第二年的测试当中，他的天赋被评为中下，当晚张绝与同学因误会而产生冲突。”
“新民国24年，张绝从大王庄搬进了井水巷，从此早出晚归和周围邻居没有任何交集。”
“之后每年的预科学校测试，张绝的成绩始终处于最差那一列，他的脾气也越来越孤僻，很少与人交流，并且多次和人发生冲突。”
“新民国27年，又一次测试中被确定没有天赋的张绝，按例应该被开除出学校，他却在雪天跪在校长黄明门前一日一夜，直至昏厥。”
“黄明最终答应再给他一年机会，然而从今年年初开始，张绝依旧毫无寸进，精神状态也愈发消沉，有人传言他已心存死志。”
“今年5月初，张绝突然一反常态不再埋头苦学，反而从校图书馆借阅各种历史文集，并常在城中各处走动。”
“在这期间，他仍然沉默寡言，但却不再像过往那样不与人交集，在城中的大街小巷顺手帮过不少小忙。”

“六月初，张绝几乎不再前往学校，只在井水巷中和邻居相处，鳏寡孤独他皆有照料，但在同学之间，他的风评也越来越差。”
“四个月后，也就在今天白天，于中甫游行开始前当众批评张绝不务正业，自甘堕落，张绝从旁经过，同行学生方勉曾试图要请他一起参加游行，遭张绝拒绝。”
“中午，游行被打断，叛乱学生四散而逃，宪警抓捕学生时波及到了井水巷。”
“晌午，张绝从车夫刘光行家离开，前往公允教堂登记转职。”
“下午3点12分，转职登记后，张绝接下任务。”
安焕然漫不经心地对这段履历做出了评价。
“听起来是一个家破人亡，脾气暴躁，性格孤僻的怪胎。
文官低头道。
“唯一的问题就出在今天，按照预科学校的记录，张绝无论如何都没有成为职业者的天赋，但他偏偏就在一日之间就完成了转职。”
content_en:
When night fell over the entire Jiangning, he was still in that magnificent office.
An Huanran curled up on the large high-backed chair, yawning and listening to his civil servants read to him the information from the Governor's Mansion.
"In the 27th year after Jin Tianyou, Zhang Cheng, a teacher in Tieshan County, Pengcheng, Jiangbei, gave birth to a son, Zhang Huaixi."
"Zhang Huaixi studied at the beginning, but failed in thirteen years, so he became a carpenter's apprentice, and finally started working as a carpenter."
"In the 10th year of the New Republic of China, Zhang Huaixi married Xu and gave birth to their son Zhang Jue. In the same year, the family moved from Jiangbei to Jiangning City in the south of the Yangtze River to avoid the disaster of war. Zhang Huaixi still worked as a carpenter."
"Zhang Jue, a native of Dawangzhuang, Jiangning City, Jiangnan, was dull and talkative since he was a child. He couldn't speak at the age of three. Therefore, Xu suspected that he had mute syndrome and traveled around to seek medical treatment. He was unable to communicate with others until he was four years old."
"When Zhang Jue was six years old, his parents sent him to a school, but the teacher in the school was unwilling to accept him. He said that he was naturally stupid and was not good at studying. Zhang Jue felt that the teacher was scolding him and bit him on the arm."
"Thereafter, from the age of six to nine, Zhang Jue stayed at home and was taught by his mother Xu to read. After only three years of studying, Zhang Jue was able to write articles and poems. It was said in the countryside that Zhang Jue had great talent and was a literary star."
"When Zhang Jue was nine years old, Zhang Huaixi responded to the propaganda of the New Republic of China government and joined the army to join the Northern Expeditionary Army. At that time, the War to Protect the Law began, and Zhang Huaixi was killed in the Battle of Jingfu."
"At the critical moment of the Guardian War, the New Republic of China government established the Guardian Cemetery in order to expand its military resources and encourage more people to join the army. Zhang Huaixi was selected to be buried in the park, and the death benefit was personally delivered to his home by the then mayor of Jiangning City."
"After meeting Zhang Jue, the mayor of Jiangning City expressed his gratitude to his father for his loyalty and bravery, and named him Shaoxian."
"Mr. Xu was seriously ill at the time. After receiving the pension, no matter how much Zhang Jue cried and persuaded him, he was still unwilling to take the money to treat his illness. Instead, he hid the money and only told Zhang Jue before he died that he could use the pension to attend Master Sanxing Preparatory School."
"Zhang Jue obeyed Xu's last wish and officially entered the preparatory school. When he first entered the school, both teachers and students commented on him as working hard and studying hard."
"But in the second-year test, his talent was rated as average. That night, Zhang Jue had a conflict with his classmates due to a misunderstanding."
"In the 24th year of the New Republic of China, Zhang Jue moved from Dawangzhuang to Jingshui Lane. From then on, he went out early and came home late and had no interaction with the surrounding neighbors."
"In every subsequent preparatory school test, Zhang Jue's scores were always among the worst. His temper became more and more withdrawn, he rarely communicated with others, and he had many conflicts with others."
"In the 27th year of the Republic of China, Zhang Jue, who was determined to have no talent in another test, should have been expelled from the school as a rule, but he knelt in front of Principal Huang Ming's door in the snow for a day and a night until he fainted."
"Huang Ming finally agreed to give him another year's chance. However, since the beginning of this year, Zhang Jue has still made no progress and his mental state has become increasingly depressed. There are rumors that he has death aspirations."
"At the beginning of May this year, Zhang Jue suddenly stopped studying hard and uncharacteristically stopped studying. Instead, he borrowed various historical collections from the school library and often walked around the city."
"During this period, he was still taciturn, but he was no longer as isolated from others as he used to be. He helped a lot of small favors in the streets and alleys of the city."
"At the beginning of June, Zhang Jue almost stopped going to school and only spent time with his neighbors in Jingshui Lane. He took care of himself when he was alone, but his reputation among his classmates was getting worse and worse."
"Four months later, in the daytime today, before the parade started, Yu Zhongfu publicly criticized Zhang Jue for not doing his job properly and for being self-degenerate. Zhang Jue passed by. Fellow student Fang Mian tried to invite him to participate in the parade, but Zhang Jue refused."
"At noon, the march was interrupted, and the rebel students fled in all directions. When the military police arrested the students, it spread to Jingshui Lane."
"At noon, Zhang Jue followed the coachman LiuExpert Guang left and went to the Fair Church to register for job transfer. "
"At 3:12 p.m., after registering for job transfer, Zhang Jue took over the task. "
An Huanran commented on this resume casually.
“It sounds like he has a broken family, a bad temper, and a withdrawn personality.
The civil servant lowered his head and said.
"The only problem is today. According to the records of the prep school, Zhang Jue doesn't have the talent to become a professional anyway, but he happened to complete the job transfer in one day."
